messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Renjin on java 11
parts:
Hi,

As java 8 will reach end of Premier support of Java 8 in march, I have created a java11 branch (https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/tree/j11-beta1) which is based on java11 and also has most of the dependencies upgraded.

I have been running my stuff on this branch for several week now and initially found some things that I've fixed but it has been smooth after that. My usage is perhaps a bit narrow though (I am mainly using base R and mostly various relational database interactions i.e some forecasting, reports with plots etc., various financial calculations etc.) so it would be great if other people would give it a go as well and provide feed-back.

Maybe we could make a special release of it available somehow or I could create a special version of Ride for it... Please let me know if there are any takers and we can figure out together how to make it easily available for testing.

Best regards,
Per
